limitations: This is partial HTTP/API behavior coverage, not complete Std.Http or complete upstream-suite acceptance.
No other native OS/architecture is validated by these Linux x64 tests.
Empty runtime PATH is checked; this HTTP harness does not enforce kernel denial of source/build paths.
Only redundant generated metadata cache copies are reclaimed after hashing against retained deployment data; shipping build behavior is unchanged.
